head: ChatGPT account suspended for 24 hours over child abuse prompts
dek: ChatGPT now warns people who try prompts that sexualize children, points them to support, and suspends the account for 24 hours; doing it again can get the account removed for good. OpenAI announced it on 16 November with a free image classifier for selected companies.
details: ChatGPT already blocked such content and requests. The new classifier, built with the National Center for Missing and Exploited Children, spots abuse images including AI-made ones and gives each a score for reviewers; selected companies get it through OpenAI's API at no cost. In early tests with partners it flagged 48% fewer images while finding the same number of abusive ones. OpenAI also published guidance for developers and tools and training for investigators.
means: For ordinary ChatGPT users nothing changes; the warning and the 24-hour suspension only hit accounts that ask for this content.
todo: Nothing to do for ordinary use; the warning appears only when someone tries such a prompt.
